review.why: Maps direct competitors, adjacent tools and workarounds into a feature matrix and a testable 'one percent better' bet.
review.summary: Five steps: record what users do today, discover direct, adjacent and DIY competitors plus the do-nothing option, analyze segment and industry gaps, build a feature matrix, then state a 1% better hypothesis with evidence. Each competitor becomes a numbered intelligence entry, and a quality-gate checklist closes the work.
strengths: Documents current user behaviour before looking at competitors
Counts workarounds and doing nothing as competition
Quality gates and an anti-pattern table
cautions: Built around one product-requirements framework: depends on earlier steps and on its CFD- and BR- numbering
Templates and research prompts are in files not read here
Less useful outside a PRD workflow
